email.subject: Quick fix for Salt Flat Pros' site
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I checked Salt Flat Pros Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers:

1. It's not mobile-friendly. Most people searching for auto care in Harbor Falls do it from their phone while their car's acting up - if the site doesn't work there, they call the next shop instead.
2. The footer still shows old info (hours, year, etc.), which makes people second-guess whether you're still open or active.

I fix issues like these for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and how to fix it? No obligation.

Alex
Northlight Web
